panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子弯腰换鞋（从运动鞋换到拖鞋）；一只手把包挂到衣帽钩上；脸仍是 3/4 侧面；身体动作流畅但紧绷；身后背景：玄关的鞋柜、衣帽钩。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 整天就是知道打游戏打游戏，钻那游戏里面，那家里不用我说，肯定又是……

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot in the entryway of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman captured mid-motion bending down to switch from her white sneakers to the house slippers, one hand reaching up to hang her small crossbody bag on a wall-mounted coat hook. Yoga-class-returned outfit: sage green zip-up jacket, charcoal grey leggings, the white sneakers being stepped out of. Face shown in three-quarter side view, the scowl still locked in place, eyebrows drawn down and inward, eyes narrowed, mouth closed. Long straight black hair in a loosened high ponytail with several strands escaped around the face. Single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the hand hanging the bag. Warm yellow-white entryway light. Background: the entryway shoe cabinet with several pairs of shoes, a small umbrella stand, a wall clock showing evening time. Mood: the seamless transition from outdoors to in-command. Text watermark 'P12-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the room, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, anime anger vein marks, romantic soft lighting
